description: Source code for the Battery class implementation, including methods for setting modules, thermal modeling, and data management within a battery system.

classes.name: Battery
classes.description: Implementation of a Battery class managing modules, thermal behavior, and data within a battery system.

methods.name: setSeriesandParallel
methods.description: Sets the number of series and parallel cells in the battery configuration.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Connects a module to the battery, ensuring compatibility and initializing cooling systems.

methods.name: checkVoltage
methods.description: Checks the voltage of the battery cells and scales by the number of series cells.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Retrieves the current states of the cells and battery temperature.

methods.name: setBlockDegAndTherm
methods.description: Blocks or unblocks temperature and degradation updates for the battery and its cells.

methods.name: setStates
methods.description: Sets the states of the cells and updates the battery temperature.

methods.name: getAndResetConvLosses
methods.description: Returns the accumulated converter losses and resets the counter.

methods.name: thermalModel
methods.description: Calculates the thermal behavior of the battery, including temperature updates based on heat exchange and losses.

methods.name: getCoolingLoad
methods.description: Calculates the energy required for cooling the battery and its cells.

methods.name: timeStep_CC
methods.description: Advances the battery simulation by a time step, updating states, thermal behavior, and losses.

methods.name: storeData
methods.description: Stores current data of the battery, cells, and cooling system.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes stored data to files with a specified prefix.
